definitions.gloss: elevation drawing; elevation view; front/side elevation
definitions.explanation: A drawing that shows a building as seen from the front, back, or side — representing the exterior as a flat, two-dimensional image. Used in architecture alongside plan views and cross-sections.

examples.japanese: ビルの{立面図|りつめんず}。
examples.english: The elevation drawing of a building.

examples.japanese: {立面図|りつめんず}を{見|み}れば、{建物|たてもの}の{外観|がいかん}が{分|わ}かる。
examples.english: You can tell what the building will look like from the elevation drawing.

examples.japanese: {正面|しょうめん}の{立面図|りつめんず}と{側面|そくめん}の{立面図|りつめんず}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the front elevation and side elevation drawings.

examples.japanese: {建築|けんちく}の{図面|ずめん}には、{平面図|へいめんず}・{立面図|りつめんず}・{断面図|だんめんず}の{三種類|さんしゅるい}がある。
examples.english: Architectural drawings come in three main types: plan, elevation, and cross-section.

notes:
Composed of {立面|りつめん} (vertical face, elevation) and {図|ず} (diagram, drawing). A {立面図|りつめんず} depicts a building's exterior from a particular direction — typically the front, rear, or side — showing walls, windows, doors, and the overall shape without perspective distortion.

USAGE:
Standard term in architecture, construction, and civil engineering documents. Often specified by direction: {正面|しょうめん}{立面図|りつめんず} (front elevation), {背面|はいめん}{立面図|りつめんず} (rear elevation), {側面|そくめん}{立面図|りつめんず} (side elevation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立面図|りつめんず}を{描|か}く: to draw an elevation
- {立面図|りつめんず}を{作成|さくせい}する: to prepare an elevation drawing
- {正面|しょうめん}{立面図|りつめんず}: front elevation
- {立面図|りつめんず}と{平面図|へいめんず}: elevation and plan views

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {平面図|へいめんず}: floor plan, plan view — shows the building from above
- {断面図|だんめんず}: cross-section drawing — shows the interior as if sliced
- {外観図|がいかんず}: exterior drawing — similar but may include perspective or 3D rendering
- {透視図|とうしず}: perspective drawing — shows the building with depth and vanishing points
